::: {#exr-constant-prediction-decompose}

#### Predicting with one number

A city must predict the crime rate $Y$ of a randomly chosen neighborhood,
using no input at all:
it predicts the same number $c$ for every neighborhood.
Write $\mean \eqdef \E{Y}$.

Write the [expected](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) squared error of the [prediction](expectation.qmd#def-prediction) $c$,
as a function of $c$.

:::
